exercises.title: Slide check: Flux, Redux and Redux Toolkit
exercises.problemHtml:
Twelve questions on Slots 16–17: why Flux replaced two-way MVC data flow, the three principles of Redux, the Redux Toolkit API, react-redux hooks, middleware and Redux Thunk — the topics FE papers test most in the last chapter.

Tip: read every option before choosing — the wrong options are real mistakes students make in the FE exam.

Requirements

  • Answer every question in the answer panel, then press Submit.
  • All questions must be correct to get Accepted; the explanations appear after you submit.
exercises.problemHtmlVi:
Mười hai câu về Slot 16–17: vì sao Flux thay luồng dữ liệu hai chiều kiểu MVC, ba nguyên tắc của Redux, API của Redux Toolkit, hook của react-redux, middleware và Redux Thunk — những chủ đề đề FE hỏi nhiều nhất ở chương cuối.

Mẹo: đọc hết các lựa chọn rồi mới chọn — các phương án sai đều là lỗi thật sinh viên hay mắc trong đề FE.

Yêu cầu

  • Trả lời mọi câu trong khung trả lời rồi bấm Nộp.
  • Đúng hết mới được Accepted; giải thích từng câu hiện sau khi nộp.

solutionCodeJson.name: answers.md
solutionCodeJson.code:
# Slide check: Flux, Redux and Redux Toolkit — answer key

1. Main problem Flux solves compared with two-way MVC bindings in large apps:
   Answer: b) Hard-to-trace cascading updates; Flux enforces one-way data flow
   Action → dispatcher → store → view, always in one direction. / Action → dispatcher → store → view, luôn một chiều.

2. The three principles of Redux: (choose all)
   Answer: a) Single source of truth + b) State is read-only (change it by dispatching actions) + c) Changes are made with pure functions (reducers)
   One store for the whole app. / Một store cho cả app.

3. An action is…
   Answer: b) a plain object with a type describing what happened
   Often with a payload. / Thường kèm payload.

4. A reducer must NOT… (choose all)
   Answer: a) call an API + b) mutate its arguments (without Immer) + c) use Math.random()/Date.now()
   Same input ⇒ same output, no side effects. / Cùng đầu vào ⇒ cùng kết quả, không tác dụng phụ.

5. createSlice generates…
   Answer: b) a reducer and action creators from the reducers you write
   Action types are "/". / Kiểu action là "/".

6. Why can RTK reducers write state.value += 1?
   Answer: b) Immer turns the "mutations" on a draft into a new immutable state
   Either mutate the draft or return a new value, not both. / Hoặc sửa bản nháp, hoặc trả giá trị mới, không làm cả hai.

7. configureStore adds by default… (choose all)
   Answer: a) redux-thunk + b) Redux DevTools support + c) development checks for mutations/serializability
   That is why middleware: [logger] alone removes thunk. / Vì vậy middleware: [logger] một mình sẽ làm mất thunk.

8. Make the store available to components:
   Answer: a) <Provider store={store}> around the app
   From react-redux. / Của react-redux.

9. useSelector(fn)…
   Answer: b) reads a value from the store and re-renders when it changes
   useDispatch returns dispatch. / useDispatch trả về hàm dispatch.

10. Middleware signature:
   Answer: b) store => next => action => …
   Call next(action) to continue the chain. / Gọi next(action) để đi tiếp.

11. A thunk is…
   Answer: b) a function dispatched instead of an object; redux-thunk calls it with (dispatch, getState)
   Used for async logic like API calls. / Dùng cho logic bất đồng bộ như gọi API.

12. createAsyncThunk("users/fetch", fn) dispatches…
   Answer: b) users/fetch/pending, then users/fetch/fulfilled or users/fetch/rejected
   Handle them in extraReducers. / Xử lý chúng trong extraReducers.
